method.percentile: nearest rank; p50 median; successful validated HTTP responses only
method.cache: warm/mixed shared cache; no OS/DB cache eviction
method.client: Python stdlib urllib; new HTTP request per sample, no persistent client pool
method.scope: HTTP client -> existing local Nest API -> PostgREST -> PostgreSQL; JSON body read/validated
method.load: closed-loop 100 requests at each of concurrency 5 and 10; not a saturation/capacity test
method.deepCursor: 75% boundary selected with SQL OFFSET during untimed setup; measured API uses only keyset cursor
method.limits: Synthetic data, shared development machine, active local services; no cold-cache, browser paint or sustained traffic measurement
method.authentication: Existing Admin session; fresh signed JWT; normal per-request current-session/role checks. Credentials excluded.
